        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_recurring_due AS SELECT t.id AS template_id, t.name, t.kind, t.direction, t.default_amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.next_due_date_key, t.interval_unit, t.interval_count, t.payee_id, t.default_account_id, t.default_payment_method_id, t.tag_id, t.auto_remind, t.remind_days_before, o.id AS occurrence_id, o.due_date_key AS occurrence_due_date_key, o.status FROM recurring_templates AS t LEFT JOIN recurring_occurrences AS o ON o.template_id = t.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_paused = 0",

    {

      ],
      "type": "view",
      "data": {
        "name": "v_item_stock",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id",
        "dart_info_name": "VItemStock",
        "columns": [
          {
            "name": "item_id",
            "getter_name": "itemId",
            "moor_type": "string",

        "name": "v_batch_stock_check",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL",

        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL",

  "fixed_sql": [
    {
      "name": "items_fts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"items_fts\" USING fts5(name, notes, content = items, content_rowid = rowid);"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "units",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"units\" (\"code\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"category\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"factor_to_base_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"display_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"code\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"items\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"unit_category\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"default_display_unit_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"item_kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"low_stock_threshold_milli\" INTEGER NULL, \"expiry_notify_days\" INTEGER NULL, \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"is_favorite\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_favorite\" IN (0, 1)), \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_insert",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (\"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.name, new.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_delete",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, \"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.name, old.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_update",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, \"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.name, old.notes);INSERT INTO items_fts (\"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.name, new.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transactions_fts\" USING fts5(note, content = transactions, content_rowid = rowid);"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "currencies",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"currencies\" (\"code\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"symbol\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"decimal_digits\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"is_enabled\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_enabled\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"code\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "accounts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"accounts\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"opening_balance_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"opening_balance_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"color_argb\" INTEGER NULL, \"icon_key\" TEXT NULL, \"is_archived\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_archived\" IN (0, 1)), \"include_in_net_worth\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"include_in_net_worth\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "payment_methods",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"payment_methods\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "payees",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"payees\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"phone\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "tags",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"tags\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"color_argb\" INTEGER NULL, \"icon_key\" TEXT NULL, \"parent_tag_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), \"allowed_in_deposit\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_deposit\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_withdrawal\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_withdrawal\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_inventory\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_inventory\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_shopping\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_shopping\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_recurring\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_recurring\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_service\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_service\" IN (0, 1)), \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recurring_occurrences",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recurring_occurrences\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"template_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"due_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"status\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"paid_transaction_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), \"paid_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"paid_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "inventory_batches",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"inventory_batches\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"item_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), \"initial_quantity_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"remaining_quantity_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"unit_code_at_purchase\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"expiry_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchased_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"unit_cost_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"cost_currency_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"source_transaction_line_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), \"origin\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"storage_location\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transaction_lines",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transaction_lines\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"transaction_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), \"line_no\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"description\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"item_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), \"quantity_milli\" INTEGER NULL, \"unit_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"unit_price_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"line_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"destination\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"created_batch_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), \"created_asset_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), \"created_recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "assets",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"assets\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"type\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"brand\" TEXT NULL, \"model_no\" TEXT NULL, \"serial_no\" TEXT NULL, \"purchase_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchase_price_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchase_currency_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"source_transaction_line_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), \"warranty_start_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"warranty_end_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"warranty_provider\" TEXT NULL, \"warranty_note\" TEXT NULL, \"service_interval_days\" INTEGER NULL, \"next_service_due_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"primary_contact_name\" TEXT NULL, \"primary_contact_phone\" TEXT NULL, \"location\" TEXT NULL, \"linked_recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"status\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"disposed_at_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"disposal_reason\" TEXT NULL, \"disposal_note\" TEXT NULL, \"disposal_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recurring_templates",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recurring_templates\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"direction\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"default_amount_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"payee_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), \"default_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"default_payment_method_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), \"tag_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), \"interval_unit\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"interval_count\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"anchor_day_of_month\" INTEGER NULL, \"anchor_month\" INTEGER NULL, \"anchor_weekday\" INTEGER NULL, \"start_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"end_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"next_due_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"is_paused\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_paused\" IN (0, 1)), \"auto_remind\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"auto_remind\" IN (0, 1)), \"remind_days_before\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"linked_asset_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transactions\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"subtype\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"occurred_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"month_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"original_amount_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"original_currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"from_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"to_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"payment_method_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), \"payee_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"needs_review\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"needs_review\" IN (0, 1)), \"recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"recurring_occurrence_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_occurrences (id), \"converted_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"converted_currency_code\" TEXT NULL, \"conversion_rate\" REAL NULL, \"conversion_rate_raw\" TEXT NULL, \"conversion_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"delete_reason\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"), CHECK (original_amount_minor > 0), CHECK ((kind IN ('deposit','adjustmentIncrease') AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind IN ('withdrawal','adjustmentDecrease') AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'transfer' AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id <> to_account_id)), CHECK (date_key / 100 = month_key));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts_after_insert",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (\"rowid\", note) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.note);END"

      "name": "v_calendar_events",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0"

        }
      ]

          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_batch_stock_check",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }

        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_active_transactions",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_active_transactions AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.kind, t.subtype, t.occurred_at, t.date_key, t.month_key, t.original_amount_minor, t.original_currency_code, t.from_account_id, fa.name AS from_account_name, t.to_account_id, ta.name AS to_account_name, t.payment_method_id, pm.name AS payment_method_name, t.payee_id, p.name AS payee_name, t.note, t.needs_review, t.recurring_template_id, t.recurring_occurrence_id, t.converted_amount_minor, t.converted_currency_code, t.conversion_rate, t.conversion_rate_raw, t.conversion_date_key, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN accounts AS fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN accounts AS ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods AS pm ON pm.id = t.payment_method_id LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]

    {
      "name": "v_transaction_allocation",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_monthly_totals",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_monthly_totals AS SELECT month_key, kind, original_currency_code AS currency_code, SUM(original_amount_minor) AS sum_minor, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY month_key, kind, original_currency_code"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_account_ledger",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_ledger AS SELECT id AS tx_id, to_account_id AS account_id, original_amount_minor AS signed_minor, original_currency_code AS currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('deposit', 'adjustmentIncrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('withdrawal', 'adjustmentDecrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer' UNION ALL SELECT id, to_account_id, original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer'"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_account_balances",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_balances AS SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.currency_code AS currency_code, a.opening_balance_minor + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.signed_minor) FROM v_account_ledger AS l WHERE l.account_id = a.id), 0) AS balance_minor FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "notification_schedule",

      "type": "view",
      "data": {
        "name": "v_calendar_events",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0",
        "dart_info_name": "VCalendarEvents",
        "columns": [

        "name": "v_recurring_due",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_recurring_due AS SELECT t.id AS template_id, t.name, t.kind, t.direction, t.default_amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.next_due_date_key, t.interval_unit, t.interval_count, t.payee_id, t.default_account_id, t.default_payment_method_id, t.tag_id, t.auto_remind, t.remind_days_before, o.id AS occurrence_id, o.due_date_key AS occurrence_due_date_key, o.status FROM recurring_templates AS t LEFT JOIN recurring_occurrences AS o ON o.template_id = t.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_paused = 0",

        "name": "v_item_stock",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id",

        "name": "v_batch_stock_check",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL",

  "fixed_sql": [
    {
      "name": "items_fts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"items_fts\" USING fts5(name, notes, content = items, content_rowid = rowid);"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "units",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"units\" (\"code\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"category\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"factor_to_base_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"display_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"code\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"items\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"unit_category\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"default_display_unit_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"item_kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"low_stock_threshold_milli\" INTEGER NULL, \"expiry_notify_days\" INTEGER NULL, \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"is_favorite\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_favorite\" IN (0, 1)), \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_insert",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (\"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.name, new.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_delete",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, \"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.name, old.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_update",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, \"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.name, old.notes);INSERT INTO items_fts (\"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.name, new.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transactions_fts\" USING fts5(note, content = transactions, content_rowid = rowid);"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "currencies",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"currencies\" (\"code\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"symbol\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"decimal_digits\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"is_enabled\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_enabled\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"code\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "accounts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"accounts\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"opening_balance_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"opening_balance_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"color_argb\" INTEGER NULL, \"icon_key\" TEXT NULL, \"is_archived\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_archived\" IN (0, 1)), \"include_in_net_worth\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"include_in_net_worth\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "payment_methods",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"payment_methods\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "payees",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"payees\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"phone\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "tags",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"tags\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"color_argb\" INTEGER NULL, \"icon_key\" TEXT NULL, \"parent_tag_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), \"allowed_in_deposit\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_deposit\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_withdrawal\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_withdrawal\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_inventory\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_inventory\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_shopping\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_shopping\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_recurring\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_recurring\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_service\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_service\" IN (0, 1)), \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recurring_occurrences",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recurring_occurrences\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"template_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"due_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"status\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"paid_transaction_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), \"paid_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"paid_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "inventory_batches",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"inventory_batches\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"item_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), \"initial_quantity_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"remaining_quantity_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"unit_code_at_purchase\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"expiry_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchased_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"unit_cost_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"cost_currency_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"source_transaction_line_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), \"origin\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"storage_location\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transaction_lines",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transaction_lines\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"transaction_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), \"line_no\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"description\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"item_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), \"quantity_milli\" INTEGER NULL, \"unit_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"unit_price_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"line_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"destination\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"created_batch_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), \"created_asset_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), \"created_recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "assets",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"assets\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"type\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"brand\" TEXT NULL, \"model_no\" TEXT NULL, \"serial_no\" TEXT NULL, \"purchase_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchase_price_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchase_currency_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"source_transaction_line_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), \"warranty_start_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"warranty_end_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"warranty_provider\" TEXT NULL, \"warranty_note\" TEXT NULL, \"service_interval_days\" INTEGER NULL, \"next_service_due_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"primary_contact_name\" TEXT NULL, \"primary_contact_phone\" TEXT NULL, \"location\" TEXT NULL, \"linked_recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"status\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"disposed_at_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"disposal_reason\" TEXT NULL, \"disposal_note\" TEXT NULL, \"disposal_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recurring_templates",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recurring_templates\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"direction\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"default_amount_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"payee_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), \"default_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"default_payment_method_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), \"tag_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), \"interval_unit\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"interval_count\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"anchor_day_of_month\" INTEGER NULL, \"anchor_month\" INTEGER NULL, \"anchor_weekday\" INTEGER NULL, \"start_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"end_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"next_due_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"is_paused\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_paused\" IN (0, 1)), \"auto_remind\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"auto_remind\" IN (0, 1)), \"remind_days_before\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"linked_asset_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transactions\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"subtype\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"occurred_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"month_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"original_amount_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"original_currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"from_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"to_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"payment_method_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), \"payee_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"needs_review\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"needs_review\" IN (0, 1)), \"recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"recurring_occurrence_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_occurrences (id), \"converted_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"converted_currency_code\" TEXT NULL, \"conversion_rate\" REAL NULL, \"conversion_rate_raw\" TEXT NULL, \"conversion_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"delete_reason\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"), CHECK (original_amount_minor > 0), CHECK ((kind IN ('deposit','adjustmentIncrease') AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind IN ('withdrawal','adjustmentDecrease') AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'transfer' AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id <> to_account_id)), CHECK (date_key / 100 = month_key));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts_after_insert",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (\"rowid\", note) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.note);END"
        }
      ]

        }

    {
      "name": "v_calendar_events",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_recurring_due",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_recurring_due AS SELECT t.id AS template_id, t.name, t.kind, t.direction, t.default_amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.next_due_date_key, t.interval_unit, t.interval_count, t.payee_id, t.default_account_id, t.default_payment_method_id, t.tag_id, t.auto_remind, t.remind_days_before, o.id AS occurrence_id, o.due_date_key AS occurrence_due_date_key, o.status FROM recurring_templates AS t LEFT JOIN recurring_occurrences AS o ON o.template_id = t.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_paused = 0"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_asset_alerts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_asset_alerts AS SELECT a.id AS asset_id, a.name, a.type, a.status, a.warranty_end_date_key, a.next_service_due_date_key, a.service_interval_days, a.primary_contact_name, a.primary_contact_phone FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' AND(a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL OR a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL)"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_item_stock",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_batch_stock_check",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_low_stock",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_low_stock AS SELECT s.item_id, s.unit_category, s.total_remaining_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli - s.total_remaining_milli AS shortfall_milli, s.nearest_expiry_date_key FROM v_item_stock AS s WHERE s.is_low_stock = 1"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_active_transactions",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_active_transactions AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.kind, t.subtype, t.occurred_at, t.date_key, t.month_key, t.original_amount_minor, t.original_currency_code, t.from_account_id, fa.name AS from_account_name, t.to_account_id, ta.name AS to_account_name, t.payment_method_id, pm.name AS payment_method_name, t.payee_id, p.name AS payee_name, t.note, t.needs_review, t.recurring_template_id, t.recurring_occurrence_id, t.converted_amount_minor, t.converted_currency_code, t.conversion_rate, t.conversion_rate_raw, t.conversion_date_key, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN accounts AS fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN accounts AS ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods AS pm ON pm.id = t.payment_method_id LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_transaction_allocation",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_monthly_totals",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_monthly_totals AS SELECT month_key, kind, original_currency_code AS currency_code, SUM(original_amount_minor) AS sum_minor, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY month_key, kind, original_currency_code"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_account_ledger",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_ledger AS SELECT id AS tx_id, to_account_id AS account_id, original_amount_minor AS signed_minor, original_currency_code AS currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('deposit', 'adjustmentIncrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('withdrawal', 'adjustmentDecrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer' UNION ALL SELECT id, to_account_id, original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer'"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_account_balances",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_balances AS SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.currency_code AS currency_code, a.opening_balance_minor + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.signed_minor) FROM v_account_ledger AS l WHERE l.account_id = a.id), 0) AS balance_minor FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recipes",

          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recipes\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"servings\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"prep_minutes\" INTEGER NULL, \"cook_minutes\" INTEGER NULL, \"is_favorite\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_favorite\" IN (0, 1)), \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"

    {
      "name": "notification_schedule",

        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",

        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "backup_history",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"backup_history\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"file_path\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"size_bytes\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"schema_version\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"app_version\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"record_counts_json\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "analytics_cache",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"analytics_cache\" (\"cache_key\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"params_hash\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"payload_json\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"computed_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"stale_after\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"cache_key\"));"

      "type": "view",
      "data": {
        "name": "v_calendar_events",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0",
        "dart_info_name": "VCalendarEvents",
        "columns": [
          {
            "name": "date_key",
            "getter_name": "dateKey",
            "moor_type": "int",

        "name": "v_item_stock",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id",

        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL",

        "name": "v_transaction_allocation",
        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL",

        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_ledger AS SELECT id AS tx_id, to_account_id AS account_id, original_amount_minor AS signed_minor, original_currency_code AS currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('deposit', 'adjustmentIncrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('withdrawal', 'adjustmentDecrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer' UNION ALL SELECT id, to_account_id, original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer'",

  "fixed_sql": [
    {
      "name": "items_fts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"items_fts\" USING fts5(name, notes, content = items, content_rowid = rowid);"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "units",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"units\" (\"code\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"category\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"factor_to_base_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"display_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"code\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"items\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"unit_category\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"default_display_unit_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"item_kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"low_stock_threshold_milli\" INTEGER NULL, \"expiry_notify_days\" INTEGER NULL, \"density_milli_grams_per_ml\" INTEGER NULL, \"milli_grams_per_piece\" INTEGER NULL, \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"is_favorite\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_favorite\" IN (0, 1)), \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_insert",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (\"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.name, new.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_delete",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, \"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.name, old.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "items_fts_after_update",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, \"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.name, old.notes);INSERT INTO items_fts (\"rowid\", name, notes) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.name, new.notes);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transactions_fts\" USING fts5(note, content = transactions, content_rowid = rowid);"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "currencies",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"currencies\" (\"code\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"symbol\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"decimal_digits\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"is_enabled\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_enabled\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"code\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "accounts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"accounts\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"opening_balance_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"opening_balance_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"color_argb\" INTEGER NULL, \"icon_key\" TEXT NULL, \"is_archived\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_archived\" IN (0, 1)), \"include_in_net_worth\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"include_in_net_worth\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "payment_methods",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"payment_methods\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "payees",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"payees\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"phone\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "tags",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"tags\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"color_argb\" INTEGER NULL, \"icon_key\" TEXT NULL, \"parent_tag_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), \"allowed_in_deposit\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_deposit\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_withdrawal\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_withdrawal\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_inventory\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_inventory\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_shopping\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_shopping\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_recurring\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_recurring\" IN (0, 1)), \"allowed_in_service\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"allowed_in_service\" IN (0, 1)), \"is_system\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_system\" IN (0, 1)), \"sort_order\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recurring_occurrences",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recurring_occurrences\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"template_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"due_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"status\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"paid_transaction_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), \"paid_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"paid_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "inventory_batches",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"inventory_batches\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"item_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), \"initial_quantity_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"remaining_quantity_milli\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"unit_code_at_purchase\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"expiry_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchased_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"unit_cost_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"cost_currency_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"source_transaction_line_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), \"origin\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"storage_location\" TEXT NULL, \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transaction_lines",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transaction_lines\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"transaction_id\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), \"line_no\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"description\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"item_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), \"quantity_milli\" INTEGER NULL, \"unit_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES units (code), \"unit_price_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"line_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"destination\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"created_batch_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), \"created_asset_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), \"created_recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "assets",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"assets\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"type\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"brand\" TEXT NULL, \"model_no\" TEXT NULL, \"serial_no\" TEXT NULL, \"purchase_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchase_price_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"purchase_currency_code\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"source_transaction_line_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), \"warranty_start_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"warranty_end_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"warranty_provider\" TEXT NULL, \"warranty_note\" TEXT NULL, \"service_interval_days\" INTEGER NULL, \"next_service_due_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"primary_contact_name\" TEXT NULL, \"primary_contact_phone\" TEXT NULL, \"location\" TEXT NULL, \"linked_recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"status\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"disposed_at_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"disposal_reason\" TEXT NULL, \"disposal_note\" TEXT NULL, \"disposal_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"notes\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "recurring_templates",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"recurring_templates\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"normalized_name\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"direction\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"default_amount_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"payee_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), \"default_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"default_payment_method_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), \"tag_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), \"interval_unit\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"interval_count\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"anchor_day_of_month\" INTEGER NULL, \"anchor_month\" INTEGER NULL, \"anchor_weekday\" INTEGER NULL, \"start_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"end_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"next_due_date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"is_paused\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"is_paused\" IN (0, 1)), \"auto_remind\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"auto_remind\" IN (0, 1)), \"remind_days_before\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"linked_asset_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"transactions\" (\"id\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"kind\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"subtype\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"occurred_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"date_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"month_key\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"original_amount_minor\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"original_currency_code\" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), \"from_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"to_account_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), \"payment_method_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), \"payee_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), \"note\" TEXT NULL, \"needs_review\" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (\"needs_review\" IN (0, 1)), \"recurring_template_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), \"recurring_occurrence_id\" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_occurrences (id), \"converted_amount_minor\" INTEGER NULL, \"converted_currency_code\" TEXT NULL, \"conversion_rate\" REAL NULL, \"conversion_rate_raw\" TEXT NULL, \"conversion_date_key\" INTEGER NULL, \"delete_reason\" TEXT NULL, \"created_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"updated_at\" INTEGER NOT NULL, \"deleted_at\" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY (\"id\"), CHECK (original_amount_minor > 0), CHECK ((kind IN ('deposit','adjustmentIncrease') AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind IN ('withdrawal','adjustmentDecrease') AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'transfer' AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id <> to_account_id)), CHECK (date_key / 100 = month_key));"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts_after_insert",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (\"rowid\", note) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.note);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts_after_delete",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (transactions_fts, \"rowid\", note) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.note);END"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "transactions_fts_after_update",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (transactions_fts, \"rowid\", note) VALUES ('delete', old.\"rowid\", old.note);INSERT INTO transactions_fts (\"rowid\", note) VALUES (new.\"rowid\", new.note);END"
        }
      ]
    },

    {
      "name": "v_calendar_events",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_recurring_due",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_recurring_due AS SELECT t.id AS template_id, t.name, t.kind, t.direction, t.default_amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.next_due_date_key, t.interval_unit, t.interval_count, t.payee_id, t.default_account_id, t.default_payment_method_id, t.tag_id, t.auto_remind, t.remind_days_before, o.id AS occurrence_id, o.due_date_key AS occurrence_due_date_key, o.status FROM recurring_templates AS t LEFT JOIN recurring_occurrences AS o ON o.template_id = t.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_paused = 0"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_asset_alerts",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_asset_alerts AS SELECT a.id AS asset_id, a.name, a.type, a.status, a.warranty_end_date_key, a.next_service_due_date_key, a.service_interval_days, a.primary_contact_name, a.primary_contact_phone FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' AND(a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL OR a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL)"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_item_stock",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_batch_stock_check",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_low_stock",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_low_stock AS SELECT s.item_id, s.unit_category, s.total_remaining_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli - s.total_remaining_milli AS shortfall_milli, s.nearest_expiry_date_key FROM v_item_stock AS s WHERE s.is_low_stock = 1"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_active_transactions",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_active_transactions AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.kind, t.subtype, t.occurred_at, t.date_key, t.month_key, t.original_amount_minor, t.original_currency_code, t.from_account_id, fa.name AS from_account_name, t.to_account_id, ta.name AS to_account_name, t.payment_method_id, pm.name AS payment_method_name, t.payee_id, p.name AS payee_name, t.note, t.needs_review, t.recurring_template_id, t.recurring_occurrence_id, t.converted_amount_minor, t.converted_currency_code, t.conversion_rate, t.conversion_rate_raw, t.conversion_date_key, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN accounts AS fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN accounts AS ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods AS pm ON pm.id = t.payment_method_id LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_transaction_allocation",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_monthly_totals",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_monthly_totals AS SELECT month_key, kind, original_currency_code AS currency_code, SUM(original_amount_minor) AS sum_minor, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY month_key, kind, original_currency_code"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "v_account_ledger",
      "sql": [
        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_ledger AS SELECT id AS tx_id, to_account_id AS account_id, original_amount_minor AS signed_minor, original_currency_code AS currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('deposit', 'adjustmentIncrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('withdrawal', 'adjustmentDecrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer' UNION ALL SELECT id, to_account_id, original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer'"
        }
      ]
    },
    {

        {
          "dialect": "sqlite",
          "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_account_balances AS SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.currency_code AS currency_code, a.opening_balance_minor + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.signed_minor) FROM v_account_ledger AS l WHERE l.account_id = a.id), 0) AS balance_minor FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL"
        }
      ]

        "sql": "CREATE VIEW v_split_expenses AS SELECT e.id AS split_expense_id, e.group_id AS group_id, e.transaction_id AS transaction_id, e.paid_by_payee_id AS paid_by_payee_id, e.total_amount_minor AS total_amount_minor, e.currency_code AS currency_code, e.date_key AS date_key, e.month_key AS month_key, e.title AS title, e.place AS place, e.occasion AS occasion, e.split_method AS split_method, e.settle_by_date_key AS settle_by_date_key, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.share_amount_minor) FROM split_shares AS s WHERE s.split_expense_id = e.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, e.total_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.share_amount_minor) FROM split_shares AS s WHERE s.split_expense_id = e.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT SUM(s.share_amount_minor) FROM split_shares AS s JOIN app_settings AS st ON st.\"key\" = 'split.selfPayeeId' WHERE s.split_expense_id = e.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.payee_id = st.value) AS my_share_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM split_shares AS s WHERE s.split_expense_id = e.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) AS share_count FROM split_expenses AS e WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL",
